name: Forbidden Mantra Press
tagline: A curated bookstore of sacred texts, practice and inner cultivation

affiliate.note: Tracking IDs are per marketplace and must be the Associates *tracking ID* (looks like name-20), NOT the Influencer storefront name. amazon.com (US) is owner-confirmed (see its trackingId; confirmed 2026-10-27). Enrollment for every other marketplace is unknown (enrolled:null) and must be confirmed in Associates Central. IDs are read at build time from AMAZON_TRACKING_ID_<SUFFIX> (e.g. AMAZON_TRACKING_ID_COM, _CO_UK, _DE, _FR); AMAZON_TRACKING_ID alone is treated as the amazon.com ID. Never commit credentials. `disclosure` overrides the default text for a marketplace where its programme requires specific local wording; null = use the default below until the correct wording is confirmed from that programme's agreement.

disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Links marked “Amazon” are affiliate links; buying through them costs you nothing extra.

analytics._doc: Analytics is OFF. Choose at most one provider and fill its id; nothing loads and no data leaves the browser until you do. Outbound clicks are always tagged (data-track) and emit a 'fm:outbound' DOM event for testing; providers receive them only when enabled. Cookie-free providers are listed. GA4 is deliberately unsupported until a consent mechanism exists. Snippet formats were written from memory: check them against the provider's current docs when enabling.
